summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, disclosing a common shares purchase agreement with Seven Knots, LLC establishing a US$100 million equity line of credit. The company may sell shares at 97% of the lower of the lowest sale price or VWAP, subject to a floor and 4.99% ownership cap. Consideration includes convertible promissory notes totaling up to US$2 million, convertible at 95% of 20-day VWAP with a US$3.00 floor. Joseph Gunnar acts as placement agent at 3% fee. The arrangement provides flexible capital but may create share overhang, with watch on dilution and conversion triggers.
